## Reorder.svelte

### `interface HandleProps`

- `onpointerdown` :: Starts a pointer drag on this item.
- `class` :: Classes for a drag handle.

### `interface ItemExtras`

- `dragging` :: Whether this item is currently lifted by the pointer or the keyboard.
- `handleProps` :: Spread these onto a handle (or the row) to start a pointer drag.

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The items, in visual order. Two-way bindable.
- `key` :: Returns a stable id for an item, used as the FLIP key.
- `axis` :: The axis items can be dragged along.
- `children` :: The content of one item, called with the item and its drag state.
- `onReorder` :: Called after a drop or a cancelled keyboard lift, with the next order.
